title: 5.7 Meals
unit_outcome: Name fruit, food and drinks, say what you like, want and need, ask how many and how much, and order politely at a café.
goal: Recognize lunch and dinner, and say what I eat or drink for breakfast, lunch and dinner and at what time.
grammar_function: I eat eggs for breakfast. They eat chicken for dinner. They eat lunch at one o'clock.
prerequisite: 4.5 eat breakfast; 4.10 at and o'clock; 5.2-5.3 food, drinks and drink.
speaking_outcome: Say what I eat for breakfast, lunch or dinner.
